name: Keycloak
description: Self-hosted identity provider (OIDC, OAuth2, SAML). Run one login for your other apps: create a realm, register a client, and point Grafana, Forgejo or any OIDC-capable app at it. Production mode with a Postgres store, so realms, clients and user accounts survive a restart. Sign in at /admin/ with the admin account you set below. Keycloak treats that account as a temporary admin, so create a permanent one from the console and remove it. First boot takes about 20 seconds after the image is pulled.

value.title: Admin username
value.description: Master-realm administrator, created on first boot only.

value.title: Admin password
value.description: Password for the admin console. Set on first boot only; change it later from the console itself.

value.title: Database password
value.description: Generated by the platform at instance creation. Internal to this instance: Keycloak and Postgres share it, nothing else reads it.
